title: Example: facts of one hearing (copy this file for each demo clip)
basis: Write where each fact comes from, e.g. the Senate journal or a news report, and check it before the demo

context.en: On trial: [name], [position]. The articles of impeachment charge [short list, e.g. betrayal of public trust over unliquidated funds]. Lead prosecutor: [name]. Lead defense counsel: [name]. Presiding: [Senate President name]. This session: [day number and date, what is scheduled, e.g. cross-examination of the first witness].
context.tl: Nililitis: [pangalan], [posisyon]. Ang mga paratang sa articles of impeachment: [maikling listahan]. Pangunahing prosecutor: [pangalan]. Pangunahing abogado ng depensa: [pangalan]. Namumuno: [pangalan ng Senate President]. Sesyong ito: [araw at petsa, ano ang nakatakda].
